modification: Synthetic posting written for this evaluation; not based on any real company's posting. The company name 'Glimmerquay Fulfillment Partners LLC' and the Telegram handle are invented. Scam patterns taken from FTC consumer guidance: paying for a job or certification (consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), fake checks with money sent back (same page and the 2023-05 alert), requests for Social Security and bank account numbers to set up pay and checks to buy equipment (consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes), reshipping jobs (job-scams page), reply 'INTERESTED' and contact via Telegram (consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2026/04/job-offer-text-probably-scam), unrealistic pay for little work (job-scams page).
designer_intent: Entry-level order-desk resume paired with a work-from-home order processing posting whose duties superficially match the resume. The posting carries several scam signals at once (SSN and bank details before an interview, fake-check equipment scheme, upfront certification fee, Telegram-only contact, reshipping), so the test is whether warnings fire with quotes regardless of the apparent fit.
